scientific_integrity: The universal theorem is an analytical proof; finite rational verifications corroborate and do not certify the infinite theorem. Exhaustive worldwide historical priority has not been established. Full text of an older possibly related publication was not inspected.
scientific_limitations: All edges have unit length, the graph is a Cartesian product of two simple cycles of length at least three, and the ambient comparison uses the quotient Manhattan metric. The reference torus mean uses area-uniform sampling whereas the network mean uses arclength-uniform sampling.
title: Exact network-detour and distance laws for equilateral toroidal grids
